title: trial 采集与隔离运行器
dataKind: combination regressions (no model calls, no paid run)
code: integration/trial-collector.js — collectTrial/exportTrials/assertNotObservational; exports a trial record the EXISTING evaluateStrategyExperiment accepts, and lists every unobserved field as incomplete instead of filling it
scripts/strategy-runner.mjs — frozen manifest planning, per-trial worktree isolation, budget caps handed to the executor, receipts only on a real execute

evaluatorCompatible.observed: 6 synthetic trials (2 tasks x 3 strategies) pass evaluateStrategyExperiment with a complete frozen manifest; summaries show 2 trials per arm

missingOrDuplicateRejected.observed: a deleted trial is a 'missing trial' problem (evaluator blocked); a duplicated one is an exporter problem and the evaluator throws on duplicate

conditionDriftVisible.observed: a trial whose model differs from the manifest is reported as a problem, not silently accepted

missingNumbersStayNull.observed: a missing usage bucket stays null and appears in incomplete; the total is null, never 0

noFalseSuccess.observed: cancelled/failed terminals never count as success; an unobserved terminal is exported as execution pending with status unknown, and elapsedMs is null

strategyMismatchVisible.observed: contradicting actualActions set strategyMismatch and strategyApplied false, and the evaluator blocks on 'not applied'

observationalNotExperimental.observed: a manifest without randomisation metadata is reported observational and exportTrials adds a problem

runnerPlanWritesNothing.observed: --plan prints the frozen allocation and creates no receipt directory

runnerRefusesPaidRun.observed: --execute exits 2 without --max-usd and --confirm-paid-experiment, and again without budget caps/concurrency/deadline, printing the exact reasons

runnerIsolation.observed: executePlan creates one worktree per assignment, passes the caps to every runTrial call, and writes a receipt once

noHostNoExecution.observed: without a host execution context the default adapter throws OMC/TRIAL-NO-EXECUTOR and writes no receipt

boundaries: the runner passes budget caps but cannot meter spend: the executor must enforce them and book real costs into the usage ledger
costBasis is 'estimated' — the ledger stores a computed amount and a price source, not an invoice; a truly billed run needs a receipt source that does not exist yet
the CLI --execute path cannot run in a plain process (no DSH host context) and says so instead of pretending; a host must import executePlan
history logs can be an observational baseline but are never retro-tagged as a randomised experiment
notCovered: an actual paid experiment (requires a user-approved budget)
a real host executor that spends and books costs
